entry.title: PH今日热榜 | 2026-10-12
entry.summary:
TOP1 Google EmbeddingGemma 2



【标语】：An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
【介绍】：EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind's open embedding model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space, so you can search across them from a single query. At 740M parameters it runs on-device, needing about 567MB of RAM on a Pixel 11 Pro for the full multimodal model (191MB for text only). Apache 2.0 licensed, with weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle. MTEB Code score rises from 68.76 to 78.68.

【标语】：A swarm of agents, in the same place you work
【介绍】：Stop bolting AI onto your computer. Tell it what you want and a swarm of agents does the work with you at the helm.

TOP1 Rill Browser



【标语】：The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
【介绍】：Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.
